tasks.title: Clone Git Repository
tasks.instruction: Open your terminal, run `git clone https://github.com/cs101/lab0-setup.git`, and run `cd lab0-setup` to enter the directory.
tasks.evaluation_scenario: Baseline syntax following with explicit terminal commands.

tasks.title: Create and Activate Virtual Environment
tasks.instruction: Create an isolated virtual environment using `python3 -m venv .venv`. Activate it using the standard source command for your operating system shell.
tasks.evaluation_scenario: OS-dependent ambiguity (Windows PowerShell vs macOS/Linux zsh/bash syntax differences).

tasks.title: Install Dependencies with Native Build Tools
tasks.instruction: Run `pip install -r requirements.txt`. If you hit a wheel compilation failure or missing header flags, tweak your local build configuration flags until the build succeeds.
tasks.evaluation_scenario: Unguided system debugging; risk-averse personas fear corrupting system libraries.

tasks.title: Configure Global System PATH
tasks.instruction: Poke around your shell configuration file (`.bashrc` or `.zshrc`) and export your PATH manually until the command `verify-setup` executes without returning exit code 127.
tasks.evaluation_scenario: Inclusivity bug: encourages trial-and-error edits in critical root shell config files.
